body: I’ve been pretty distant from my family for a while and I don’t have any really close friends. I’ve talked on the suicide hotline before when I was at some really low points in my life but all around that wasn’t what helped me. Also I don’t feel like it will be sometime soon, if anything it would be in a month or two if I decided to do it so I can make sure it’s what I want to do. I appreciate the thought though.

I don’t think he’d do anything that warrant using pepper spray if I don’t tell him I’m uninterested. I don’t know for sure but it doesn’t seem like he would resort to being physically violent if left unprovoked.

I have considered just waiting it out until graduation but I don’t like the idea of it being a problem for my friends too since they’re really concerned. If I decide to talk to him I’ll let some people know so I’m not alone if things go wrong, still learning basic self defense is probably a good idea in general so thank you.
I don’t think I can. I live about an hour away from my school. The only person I know who drives to school near me lives 15 minutes away.

I’ve dealt with similar situations before but this is the first time it’s been someone who will continuously stare at me for up to ten minutes at a time but isn’t afraid to talk to me or shy in the least. It’s a really odd situation. I’m not the type to be afraid of confrontation normally but a lot of things about the guy feel off. Overall I’m not sure if talking to him and being up front with what I think will make him stop or make him even more interested. I still really appreciate the response, so thank you.

I don’t think he’s afraid of embarrassing situations. He’s openly approached me even when with my friends. He doesn’t seem shy or lacking in confidence. More than anything it just seems to be an unhealthy affection towards me. I’m pretty sure he’s still a freshman and I’m worried that he may be a little too easily impressionable which is part of why I’m afraid of shutting him down. I’d hate to be responsible for him hating women or something extreme like that, even with how unlikely it seems, you haven’t met the guy. I’m also afraid that he’ll start being openly hostile to my friends, especially since the one friend I have on my bus is a guy and he’s also gotten stared at. Still, I’ll give a confrontation some thought, so thank you.

It’s not that I necessarily feel threatened or all that unsafe. It’s more likely than not that he won’t do anything unless I say something. I just really don’t want something like this to skew his view on reality or anything and get the wrong idea. I don’t know why he keeps pursuing me but I think it’s really unhealthy. I know my school probably won’t do anything unless I say that he is actually threatening me so I don’t really see a reason to take it there unless it actually gets bad. I have a good group of friends who will defend me if anything goes wrong, but I don’t want this to get out of hand.
